Enjoy our exclusive weekend lunch hot pot set, perfect for a casual dining experience! This value-packed set includes two types of broth, a selection of basic vegetables, shabu-shabu meat, offal, and our special wontons. If you're craving hot pot but find the full course too much, or if you prefer to stick to the basics and order your favorites, this set is just right for you!
